📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-ms-account-api-4xx-spike-monitor-noise`
This is occurrence #50 (last_notified_at was 2026-08-05T11:32:14Z — ~3d23h14m ago, 24h suppression window had expired).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin`
Playbook: 1) Confirm shape: monitor 299551518 in 'No Data' or newly-modified state, but NOT accompanied by a genuine >300/15min 4xx count. 2) Run the evidence_query directly against the actual 4xx-hits metric -- if it's in the single digits (or empty), this is the known noise pattern. 3) Check service:ms-account-api status:error DD Logs -- expect 0 hits, consistent with all prior documented occurrences. 4) If the metric DOES show a genuine breach (hundreds of 4xx in 15 min), treat as a real incident and do not apply this KB entry -- retract the 'noise' diagnosis.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session (proxy: DD monitor 299551518, fired 2026-08-09T10:46:19Z)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: DD metric `sum:trace.aspnet_core.request.hits.by_http_status{service:ms-account-api,env:prod,http.status_class:4xx}.as_count()`, 1h window ending at fire time (2026-08-09T09:46:19Z–10:46:19Z)
  • Observed: 2 total hits (1 @10:15:00Z, 1 @10:30:00Z) — far under the 300/15min threshold
  • Corroboration: `service:ms-account-api status:error` in DD Logs, 2026-08-09T10:16:19Z–11:00:00Z → 0 hits
  • Reasoning: same monitor-sensitivity/config-artifact non-reproduction shape as 49 prior occurrences — monitor transitions state without a real 4xx breach
